scope: Two complete candidate cards and their private first-tap/conditional-timing cores; final combined release and reviews pending
shared_rules: Record every actual battlefield untapped-to-tapped transition since turn start in sparse copy-on-write exact-incarnation rows, even before observer entry, under another controller or while not a creature; duplicates, already tapped, entry-tapped and virtual funding are quiet. Cap history at first versus repeated and clear on actual new turn.

Captain collects one independent nontarget packet for each controlled creature on its controller turn, checking first-tap history at trigger and resolution. Existing entering_object and a private UntapEventObject instruction retain exact recipients; queued abilities survive observer control/departure/suppression.

Mar-Vell composes existing as-though spell filters with one private immutable requires-opponent-spell flag. Read actual opponent cast count relative to current source controller and printed ability availability; old unconditional grants keep their behavior. No costs, land timing or activation timing are changed.
